unique_value: tool decisions are bound to a deterministic policy hash instead of narrative safety claims
red-line tools fail closed with an explicit refusal reason and remain dominant over schema state
allowed decisions bind an explicit tool schema version and digest
one-shot call identity prevents later rebinding of a prior tool-call identifier
hash-chained transcript entries and deterministic replay receipts make policy decisions independently reproducible across Python and Node

next_evolution: Bind schema references to authenticated registry authority and bind verified tool-result receipts back into the transcript without confusing policy allowance with execution completion.
nonclaims: not a production Anthropic safety-control deployment

tool schema references are not authenticated registry attestations
